url.ask: OPC UA endpoint of the Vi-CELL BLU
url.help: The port is set in the Vi-CELL BLU software (Settings, automation); Beckman publishes no default. Security (user, password, certificates) must be enabled there.

user.ask: Instrument user the automation connects as
user.help: A Vi-CELL BLU user account with automation rights; the software ships a default automation account that should be replaced.

allowed_cell_types.ask: Cell types an agent may count with (JSON list; empty = any defined on the instrument)

nodes.ask: OPC UA node ids of the properties and methods (from the automation kit SDK or UaExpert)
nodes.help: Keep the keys of config.example.json; the shipped ids are placeholders.

max_minutes.ask: Longest a count, prime or clean may take
